description: This file defines a React component for a debug canvas overlay in an Excalidraw-based application, including rendering functions for drawing lines, Bezier curves, and bindings, as well as debug state management and UI controls.

classes.name: DebugCanvas
classes.description: A React component that renders a debug overlay canvas for visual debugging.

methods.name: renderLine
methods.description: Draws a line segment on the canvas context.

methods.name: renderCubicBezier
methods.description: Draws a cubic Bezier curve on the canvas context.

methods.name: renderOrigin
methods.description: Draws a cross at the origin point for debugging.

methods.name: _renderBinding
methods.description: Renders a binding curve for a fixed point binding.

methods.name: _renderBindableBinding
methods.description: Renders a binding curve for a bindable element.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders debug elements (lines or curves) onto the canvas.

methods.name: _debugRenderer
methods.description: Main function to render the debug overlay on the canvas.

methods.name: debugFrameData
methods.description: Returns the current debug frame index.
